judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core validation logic in `ToolRegistry` cleanly, but appears to have stopped mid-implementation, leaving `.lore/dod.md` and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` in the tree. More critically, the candidate uses a default import (`import Ajv from 'ajv'`) and accesses `e.dataPath` (which does not exist on Ajv v8 `ErrorObject`, only `instancePath`), both of which will fail `npm run typecheck` under NodeNext/ESM TypeScript settings. Several required acceptance criteria are also missing: the documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were never made, `CHANGELOG.md` is incomplete, and most unit tests required in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (such as extra properties passing through, dynamic schema changes per call, and unknown tool throws) are absent.
